binding_constraint.title: The booking handoff interrupts otherwise credible treatment demand.
binding_constraint.statement: The booking handoff interrupts otherwise credible treatment demand. Visitors who already found the practice lose treatment context across repeated mobile steps before a confirmed enquiry.

do_not_do.title: Do not buy more traffic into a booking path that drops treatment intent.
do_not_do.rationale: Buying more traffic before the booking path is fixed would send additional high-intent visitors into the same leak, increasing abandonment rather than confirmed enquiries.

defend.title: Defend the strongest verified subject signal
defend.rationale: Preserve the existing strength while correcting the binding constraint.

close.title: Close the clearest patient-decision gap
close.rationale: The comparable synthetic paths show a material gap before additional reach is funded.

differentiate.title: Own a clearer evidence-to-booking narrative
differentiate.rationale: The open position is not more activity; it is continuity from discovery through trust to the next step.

do_not_copy.title: Do not copy unverified visible activity
do_not_copy.rationale: Public activity and newer-looking practice do not prove effectiveness, clinical superiority or economics.

market_practice_gap.reason: The synthetic local/category comparison shows a newer decision-path pattern worth testing, but not a basis for an automatic clinical or technology replacement.

recommendations.title: Pilot the clearer market-practice pattern before replacing tools or clinical inputs
recommendations.current_state: The fictional subject separates treatment explanation, proof, price conditions and booking.
recommendations.market_shift: Fictional local and category references present those elements as one continuous patient decision path.
recommendations.evidence_scope: Synthetic local competitors plus a fictional category/positioning reference; public adoption signal only.
recommendations.business_implication: A clearer path may reduce decision friction and should be tested before additional reach is funded.
recommendations.transition_economics: Use a bounded page/process pilot and measure completion; do not commit to equipment, software or clinical replacement from this evidence.
dependencies: Qualified clinical review for any treatment, drug, device or protocol implication
recommendations.specialist_validation: Marketing owner validates the journey; a qualified clinician and applicable regulator/manufacturer authority must validate any clinical, drug, device or protocol change.
recommendations.limitations: Synthetic illustration. Adoption does not prove superiority, safety, profitability or patient fit.

current_state.constraint_detail: Repeated steps and a dropped treatment handoff interrupt high-intent visitors.

gap_inventory.title: The mobile booking path requires repeated context and too many steps.
gap_inventory.why_it_matters: High-intent treatment visitors face avoidable abandonment risk.

repair_plan.outcome: A priority-treatment visitor can reach a confirmed mobile enquiry without repeated choices or unnecessary fields.
diy_steps: Record the current mobile path from treatment entry page to acknowledgement, including every tap, required field and dead end.
Remove duplicated service/location choices and defer nonessential questions until after the enquiry is accepted.
Keep one persistent primary action and a truthful explanation of what happens after submission.
Retest on current iOS and Android viewport sizes and record the final path.
repair_plan.owner_role: Conversion-focused web implementer with practice operations acceptance
done_when: Successful test acknowledgement on two mobile viewport sizes

gap_inventory.title: Selected treatment context is lost at the booking handoff.
gap_inventory.why_it_matters: Generic enquiries create extra work and a less relevant first response.

repair_plan.outcome: The selected treatment and practice context survive the Website-to-scheduler handoff and appear in the received enquiry.
diy_steps: Define the treatment and location values that must pass from each entry page.
Map those values to supported scheduler fields or a safe query/hidden-field mechanism.
Verify the received staff notification and confirmation copy contain the intended non-clinical context.
Test direct, back-button and expired-session paths without creating an unwanted appointment.
repair_plan.owner_role: Web integration specialist with front-desk workflow acceptance
done_when: Received test enquiry with correct non-clinical context
Mobile QA evidence for direct and recovery paths
repair_plan.day_30_outcome: The first approved public correction is live and the remaining work is scoped.
repair_plan.beyond_day_30: Continue the remaining public-path work after Day 30; it is not Sprint scope by default.

gap_inventory.title: The synthetic enquiry did not receive a clear treatment-specific next step.
gap_inventory.why_it_matters: The follow-up experience does not match the credibility built before submission.

repair_plan.outcome: A permitted truthful test enquiry receives a treatment-relevant acknowledgement and owned next step within the documented service window.

focus_selection.rationale: The named reviewer selected The mobile booking path requires repeated context and too many steps. as the binding hole and the related 30-day repairs.

implementation_paths.diy: Have the operations lead and web implementer execute tasks 1–3 in order, using the acceptance evidence as the internal release checklist.
implementation_paths.other_provider: Share the full path evidence, scheduler field map and task IDs with another provider; require mobile QA and a privacy-safe received-enquiry test before acceptance.
implementation_paths.defer: Do not add traffic. Preserve the current path recording and collect the missing Social evidence while the conversion risk remains visible.
implementation_paths.caesthetic: Ask CAESTHETIC to scope the chosen web, scheduler and response-loop tasks with access, owners and acceptance proof in a separate Sprint statement.

why_caesthetic.evidence_advantage: CAESTHETIC has already connected the visible friction, technical handoff and response evidence into one dependency-aware plan.
why_caesthetic.coordination_advantage: The work needs a web implementer, booking-system knowledge, operations ownership and privacy-safe QA; a single coordinator can keep those handoffs from becoming the next failure.
why_caesthetic.sprint_boundary: This diagnosis does not commit website, scheduler or operations work. Any 30-Day Sprint selects the exact tasks and acceptance checks separately and makes no enquiry or revenue guarantee.
why_caesthetic.ownership: The practice owns the report, evidence and task plan. It may implement the same instructions internally, appoint another provider, defer them or stop without CAESTHETIC.

methodology.competitorSelection: Three named fictional injector practices selected by comparable treatments and synthetic market proximity.
methodology.limitations: All practices, people, observations, competitors and scores are synthetic. Social evidence intentionally covers only 60% of canonical weight; Social and Overall are therefore withheld. No outcome is guaranteed.
